correctness.rationale: Piecewise scalar ODE admits exact interval-state and integrated-cost formulas. Direct differentiation factors out the augmented-rate effect as a strictly positive G; strict derivative monotonicity or positivity yields a unique global minimizer on every admissible parameter region, including b=0, equality and endpoint cases. Exact regret follows by integration. Replayed code gave 71,003 assertions; analytic proof certifies quantifiers.

value.rationale: A fixed-duration mechanical cleaning episode with known finite operating availability is a motivated constrained indoor-exposure control design. The complete sharp threshold for activation, device-strength independence, and exact quantified regret of mistiming give useful actionable mathematical structure beyond a restatement of the familiar linear concentration ODE; applicability is restricted to the idealized model.
